calibration.reason: Cosine similarities are not calibrated class probabilities. Requires independently labeled calibration and test sets.

throughput.scope: small authored benchmark; not a production load test

protocol.description: Assistant-authored semantic challenge examples, authored separately from the model anchors. Not independently human reviewed, not a random production sample, not a blind or out-of-time institutional gold benchmark. Do not report these metrics as production accuracy.
protocol.sample_design: Two authored examples per known subject plus eight unknown/adversarial examples; deliberately not production weighted.
